method: Read the dispute packet (32 accepted openings; 2 disputed items, one slider with three differing opinions and one gap listed by A only; plus the flag on the passage at (13.17,-46.47)). Each dispute and the flag were decided from the drawing: zoomed renders (0.25 m grid) of the spots and prims.pkl queries of the wall hatches / wall lines / A-DOOR, A-DOOR-FRAM and A-DETL entities. (1) Packet L30W-10 (A only, gap x 2.518..4.117 at y=-37.59) rejected: it is the corridor corner between the NE corner of the west block and the NW corner of the core, no wall line crosses it and nothing is drawn across it. (2) Cavity slider at (4.268,-46.465) (A L30W-21, B L30W-18, E V30-19): ONE door, kind door, ends fixed to the wall-end faces on the wall centre line, 2.150 m (thick skin ends y=-45.390 / -47.540, the same span as the designer's dashed opening lines); frame outer faces 1.92 m and clear 1.84 m are in the notes. (3) FLAG at (13.167,-46.465): passage, NOT optional: a gap between two collinear 0.30 m wall ends of one N-S wall line, bracketed by the designer's dashed opening lines (same linetype as the slider's). Missing-opening check: one render of the whole box with a marker on every final opening (final_check_marked.png) and eight zoomed tiles at 0.5 m grid (tile_T1..T8.png), plus four scripted cross-checks on prims.pkl: (a) every A-DOOR* primitive grouped by block handle and matched to a final opening - all matched; the only unmatched group is the double door DOOR_SWING_2 900x2000 INT-4452092 (handle 3AC9) at (15.605,-50.015), whose centre lies outside this box (x>15.5), so it belongs to the east part's list; (b) every door-swing arc over 0.3 m matched to a final opening (same exception); (c) wall-end gap scan on the A-WALL hatch union (facing collinear wall ends 0.45-6 m apart with a clear line between them): every hit is a final opening except one S-COLS column casing in the wall y=-50.0 at x 12.14..13.09 (rejected, listed); (d) every non-continuous A-DETL line: only the dashed opening lines of the slider and of the flagged passage. Nothing new found, no openings added. The accepted items were kept as they are (their ends re-measured against the wall hatches / frames by the gap scan and by queries, all within 2 cm; the toilet cubicle doors checked on one stall). Ids renumbered north to south: packet ids 01-09 unchanged, packet ids 11-34 each shift down by one (packet 10 rejected; the slider, packet 21, becomes L30W-20). Final: 33 openings = 17 door, 7 door (optional), 5 passage, 4 passage (optional); 3 glass-wall runs (facade).
